props.name: color
props.description: Text color from the foreground hierarchy. Emphasis, not decoration. Defaults to foreground-2, except heading variants, which default to foreground-1.

values.name: inherit
values.whenToUse: Text sits inside a coloured container and must take its color. TODO(review): confirm.

values.name: foreground-1
values.whenToUse: Headings and maximum-emphasis text. Default for heading variants.

values.name: foreground-2
values.whenToUse: Body text. Default for non-heading variants.

values.name: foreground-3
values.whenToUse: Secondary text, metadata and timestamps. The usual choice for supporting copy.

values.name: disabled
values.whenToNotUse: Anything that is not a disabled control.

values.name: success
values.whenToUse: Text that reports a good outcome, paired with words or an icon.
values.whenToNotUse: Emphasis or branding. For a label, use Tag or StatusBadge.

values.name: warning
values.whenToUse: Text that reports a warning, paired with words or an icon.
values.whenToNotUse: Emphasis or branding. For a label, use Tag or StatusBadge.

values.name: danger
values.whenToUse: Text that reports a failure or error, paired with words or an icon.
values.whenToNotUse: Emphasis or branding. For a label, use Tag or StatusBadge.

props.name: variant
props.description: Type style. Always a named variant: never compose type from text, font and leading classes. Defaults to body-normal.

values.name: body-normal
values.whenToUse: Default body copy: paragraphs and descriptions.

values.name: heading-hero
values.whenToUse: The largest title. At most one per page. TODO(review): confirm.

values.name: heading-section
values.whenToUse: A page or major section title. TODO(review): confirm.

values.name: heading-subsection
values.whenToUse: A subsection or card title. The most used heading. TODO(review): confirm.

values.name: heading-base
values.whenToUse: A smaller heading below subsection. TODO(review): confirm.

values.name: body-single-line-normal
values.whenToUse: Body text that must not wrap: table cells, labels, chips.
values.whenToNotUse: Text that should wrap. Use body-normal.

values.name: body-strong
values.whenToUse: Emphasis within body copy, or a small title in a dense layout. TODO(review): confirm.

values.name: body-single-line-strong
values.whenToUse: Strong body text that must not wrap.
values.whenToNotUse: Text that should wrap. Use body-strong.

values.name: body-code
values.whenToUse: Code, IDs, hashes and log output in the monospace family. Renders as pre.

values.name: caption-normal
values.whenToUse: Metadata, timestamps and secondary information. The most used variant.

values.name: caption-strong
values.whenToUse: A caption that needs emphasis, such as a small label. TODO(review): confirm.

values.name: caption-single-line-normal
values.whenToUse: A caption that must not wrap.
values.whenToNotUse: Text that should wrap. Use caption-normal.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal text alignment. Not set by default, so the element's natural alignment applies.

values.name: left
values.whenToUse: Left-align text inside a centred or right-aligned parent.

values.name: center
values.whenToUse: Short centred copy such as an empty state.
values.whenToNotUse: Long paragraphs: centred long text is hard to read.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Single line with an ellipsis. Ignored when lineClamp is set. Sets a native title with the full text unless you pass your own. Pair with a tooltip so the full text stays recoverable.

props.name: lineClamp
props.description: Clamp to a number of lines with an ellipsis. Wins over truncate. Sets a native title with the full text unless you pass your own.

props.name: wrap
props.description: How text wraps. Prefer a -single-line- variant over nowrap.

values.name: nowrap
values.whenToNotUse: A wrapping variant that must stay on one line. Use a -single-line- variant.

values.name: pretty
values.whenToUse: Long body copy, to avoid a lone last word. TODO(review): confirm.

values.name: balance
values.whenToUse: Short multi-line headings, to even out the lines. TODO(review): confirm.

props.name: as
props.description: Changes the rendered HTML element to match what the content is. Use h1 to h6 for real headings, since the default element is not a heading tag. Changes meaning, not appearance.

values.name: span
values.whenToUse: Default for caption variants and inline text.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element instead of a new one, merging props. Only for wrapping an existing element such as a link.
